item.title: From a frozen Telegram photo to the Linux graphics stack
item.description: I am new to Linux graphics, not a teacher. This post records what I learned. Our AI cats Penfold, Casper and Velma helped with the research and post structure. Any mistakes are mine. Corrections are welcome. 1. The fullscreen photo that froze a laptop I opened a photo from Telegram Web in Brave and switched it to fullscreen. The display froze. After failed attempts to recover it, I forced the Framework Laptop to restart.
